recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If Pharmacy wants examples for later optional elements added after STU3, handle those with current, element-specific trackers rather than reopening this umbrella QA issue.
issue_request: FHIR-14431 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core Pharmacy umbrella change request to fix examples in Pharmacy resources so QA could find values for all attributes, naming Medication.status, MedicationAdministration.instantiates, MedicationDispense.location, MedicationDispense.performer.function, MedicationRequest.instantiates, MedicationRequest.insurance, MedicationRequest.performerType, MedicationRequest.statusReason, and related search-parameter coverage warnings.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to git-svn commit 6a66821c691aae27795820aa49a7da81cabedf82. That commit is present in current history and added the listed example values across Medication, MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationRequest examples while naming companion trackers FHIR-14524 through FHIR-14528.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini still lists Medication, MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources. Current examples retain Medication.status, MedicationDispense.location, MedicationDispense.performer.function, MedicationRequest.statusReason, MedicationRequest.performerType, MedicationRequest.insurance, and the renamed MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenser coverage. MedicationAdministration.instantiates and MedicationRequest.instantiatesCanonical/instantiatesUri are recorded as removed and are absent from current StructureDefinitions. Same-family audit commits for FHIR-14524 through FHIR-14528 are already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing removed instantiates elements or treating this applied STU3 QA cleanup as a mandate to populate every later optional R5/R6 Pharmacy element would over-read the issue.
